popover.trigger: How the popover is opened. Hover mode remains keyboard accessible.
popover.onOpenChange: Called whenever the open state changes.
popover.hoverDelayCloseDelay: Open and close delay in milliseconds for hover mode.
popover.liquid: Optionally draws a soft visual connection between anchor and panel.
popover.gooStrength: Controls the softness of the liquid merge.
popover.side: Preferred placement. The panel flips when space is constrained.
popover.align: Alignment along the anchor's cross axis.
popover.sideOffsetAlignOffset: Distance from and offset along the anchor.
popover.collisionPadding: Minimum viewport padding used during collision avoidance.
popover.contentLiquid: Overrides the root liquid setting for one panel.
